narrative.overview: Each building of the day's route is a stamp card: one circle per task, one row per floor. A task is stamped moss when the worker concludes it and the stamp falls onto the card; a task that cannot be done is stamped brick with a cross. The hour is added when the floor is checked out, and a full card is celebrated when a batch closes. The ground is stone-grey paper, the ink is graphite, a single moss stamp ink marks what is done and brick marks what is impossible. Material 3 supplies navigation and controls; the world lends only type, palette, density and the stamp gesture.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome stone and graphite, one moss accent, brick only for what is impossible or wrong.
The circle is the form for slots, progress dots and avatar; the building pin is a circle on a stem (a teardrop).
State is read by mark (stamp, dashed ring, empty, struck), never by colour alone.
Stamps sit a few degrees off-axis (-9 to +9 deg) with an irregular ink edge drawn in a CustomPainter.

rules.name: The Scarce Moss Rule
rules.body: Moss means a task is done. It is not an accent for buttons or links, and a finished building is grey, not moss.

rules.name: The Brick Is Alarm Rule
rules.body: Brick appears only when something is wrong, blocked or impossible: the error colour, the impossible stamp and the action that reports it. Done is moss and impossible is brick; there is no blue.

rules.name: The Theme-Only Colour Rule
rules.body: Screens read colour from FieldPalette / ColorScheme. A raw Colors.* or Color(0x...) outside lib/ui/app_theme.dart fails test/ui/no_raw_colors_test.dart.

rules.name: The One Display Rule
rules.body: Bowlby One SC is for the floor card title and full-card headline. Everything else is Hanken Grotesk.

rules.name: The Hairline Over Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate content with a rule border or tone step; only the map sheet carries a shadow.

rules.name: The Mark-Not-Colour Rule
rules.body: Slot and pin states are distinguished by mark: moss stamp with check and hour is done; the same with no hour and a cloud badge is stamped, waiting for the exit scan; brick stamp with a cross is impossible; dashed ink ring is next; dashed ring with pulsing dot is in progress; empty rule ring is pending; struck circle is released; a building pin carries its number, or a check on grey when finished.

dos: Do take every colour from FieldPalette or ColorScheme; add a named constant in app_theme.dart for anything new.
Do keep touch targets at 48dp or more, and the primary action a 56dp pill.
Do express state by mark and semantic label, with colour as reinforcement only.
Do keep the scan footer reachable at all three sheet heights, disabled with the reason in words rather than hidden.
Do honour reduced motion by swapping instantly.
donts: Don't use Colors.* or hex literals in screens.
Don't use moss as a decorative accent, brick for anything but what is wrong or impossible, or blue for anything.
Don't set Bowlby One SC outside the floor card title and full-card headline.
Don't convey state with colour alone.
